fusions.name: Polyp's Harpoon
fusions.desc: Fires a stinging thread up to 6 tiles. It deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Staghorn Surge
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Branching tines grow out of you, and the growth deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. The damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Stinging Colony
fusions.desc: Roots a head of living reef where you stand for 12 seconds. It deals 3 damage every second to an enemy within 4 tiles, each time with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Reef Edge
fusions.desc: 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. You have 10% water resistance.
